bullets.text: 4Chan and Kiwi Farms Sue UK - **4Chan** and **Kiwi Farms** challenge UK’s Online Safety Act, claiming it violates their rights.
Apple Faces Global Antitrust Scrutiny - **Apple** is under investigation in Colombia over its App Store practices, joining multiple countries.
London Transit Headphone Campaign - **Transport for London** urges riders to wear headphones to combat speakerphone annoyances.
WhatsApp Introduces AI Message Rephrasing - **WhatsApp** launches 'Writing Help' feature for tone adjustments and rephrasing.
Google Pixel 10 Pro Launches - **Google's** Pixel 10 Pro showcases enhanced AI features and improved hardware.
Apple's Legal Battles Over 4G Patents - **Apple** appeals UK ruling on 4G patents, fearing broader implications for mobile licensing.
Nvidia Reports Record Sales - **Nvidia** sees a 56% revenue increase, driven by AI demand in data centers.
AI in 911 Centers - **Aurelian** develops AI to assist understaffed 911 centers with non-emergency calls.
Chipolo Launches Rechargeable Trackers - **Chipolo** unveils new rechargeable trackers, competing with **Apple's** AirTags.
Tesla's Full Self-Driving Testing - **The Boring Company** tests Tesla's Full Self-Driving in Las Vegas tunnels.
